text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It's the day of Fuji Kiseki's debut. Despite being a newcomer, everyone is expecting such great things from her that even I get put into the spotlight as her trainer.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: To calm my nerves, she uses magic to conjure a piece of chocolate for me. Her magic effective, she gallantly heads off to her race.
